policy: Preserve independent functions; one canonical implementation per function; old names only delegate.

person_following.role: Official MOT/IDLE/TRACKING/LOST strategy; owned NavigateToPose and Spin actions through existing Nav2 safe velocity chain; fresh wheel-odometry stop confirmation; default dry_run

dashboard_follow_command.role: SetBool command/status adapter only; no goal or velocity generation

face_identity.role: Face enrollment/recognition using existing ROS image and official MOT; no body tracker or motion authority

navigation.role: current operational Nav2 profile; general reset/mapping modes share restart_nav_reset.sh

localization.role: AMCL/map localization; SLAM is a complementary operating mode

camera_acquisition.role: Orbbec ROS camera is the physical owner; visual runtime is a ROS-image consumer with its own process lock

base_driver.role: current driver and protected runtime; other hardware backends remain explicit alternative profiles

audio_and_voice.role: audio I/O and high-level voice integration are complementary packages

semantic_navigation.role: semantic service and interface package are complementary, not duplicates

image_inference.role: Canonical bounded BPU image inference HTTP API; ROS dynamic-mask consumer reuses its single model; no camera/device or motion ownership

visual_runtime.role: Current semantic memory and live search interfaces

contract_demo_native.role: Foxglove native demo staged goals and navigation/map status; delegates to existing Nav2 action, protected base gate and map exporter; no velocity publisher

visual_slam.role: Optional VIMS-style Astra RGB-D frontend, RTAB-Map backend, masked-depth interface and isolated Nav2 planning; legacy rtabmap_rgbd_experiment entrypoints delegate; no production SLAM handover

person_follow_gui.role: Fixed GUI experiment service adapter and image overlays; delegates to canonical follower/Nav2; no velocity publisher or body tracker
